## 4. Base rates
- Brighton have struggled against Palace in the Premier League:
  - One stats piece says they went 7 Premier League meetings without a win (5 draws, 2 losses), with three straight 1-1 draws. It's undated and is probably from about 2023-24. [SuperSport](https://supersport.com/football/premier-league/news/8a7a1cff-efb4-48ed-a4ce-f4eb7a1198d5/brighton-v-crystal-palace-what-the-stats-say)

- Generic base rate: Premier League home teams win roughly 43-46% of matches. That's my general background knowledge, not a sourced figure.
- The derby has often been low-scoring: six of the last nine meetings had two or fewer goals, according to an undated betting preview.
